basic_info.description: Welcome to Embarcadero Lofts, an architecturally striking historic conversion in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant East Cut neighborhood. This southwest-facing one-bedroom residence blends industrial-inspired design with modern comforts, featuring soaring 11-foot ceilings, polished concrete floors with radiant heat, and expansive metal casement windows offering suffused afternoon sunlight, partial city views, an open kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and in-unit washer/dryer. There is a large storage space underneath the entire bedroom area. One assigned parking space is included. #504 is in a boutique 59-unit elevator building, with front desk reception(M-F). Residents enjoy a serene landscaped courtyard, a dramatic two-story lobby, and a top floor deck with city vistas.  Just outside your door, enjoy easy access to Woodlands Market, a variety of coffee shops and restaurants, and outdoor spaces like East Cut Crossing Park, the 5.4-acre Salesforce Park, the Embarcadero waterfront, and the Ferry Building. Commuting is effortless with BART, Muni, and freeway access all nearby.
